title: Ensemble Configuration
description: Configuration file for Ensemble threading topology. Defines which actors run on which worker threads.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON schema for IDE support

threads.description: Thread topology configuration. Each key is a thread ID, and each value configures that thread's actors.

actors.description: Array of actors that should run on this thread. The Vite plugin will automatically generate a worker entry file.

path.description: Path to the file containing the actor class, relative to project root. Example: './src/actors/MetricGeneratorActor.ts'

name.description: Name of the actor class to import and register. Must match the exported class name exactly. Example: 'MetricGeneratorActor'
